expected_answer_requirements: Expire unpaid reservations after 18 minutes of inactivity.
Mention pytest tests/integration/inventory_reservation_expiry.py.
Optionally include reservation_id and expiry_reason logging.
Do not use 45-minute or manual-only cleanup behavior.
Quarantine only after three main failures within 24 hours and a linked owner ticket.
Mention swift test --filter FlakyQuarantinePolicyTests.
Optionally include owner_ticket and failure_window_hours.
Do not quarantine after one failure.
Suppress rows when consent_revoked_at is present even if opt_in is true.
Mention python -m pytest tests/consent/test_export_suppression.py.
Optionally include subject_id and suppression_reason audit fields.
Do not export revoked opt-in rows or reuse sample customer detail.
Require tax_id and bank_account verification before high-volume catalog activation.
Mention python -m pytest tests/onboarding/test_high_volume_verification.py.
Optionally include verification_status and activation_block_reason.
Do not activate while bank_account verification is pending.
Route ARR above 500000 enterprise refund cases to Escalations-Refunds within 15 minutes.
Mention python -m pytest tests/crm/test_enterprise_refund_routing.py.
Optionally include case_id, arr_band, and target_queue audit logs.
Do not route these cases to Account-Owners first.
Rotate recovery_code_set_id after any successful recovery-code login.
Mention pytest tests/security/test_recovery_code_rotation.py.
Optionally include recovery_code_rotated and recovery_code_denied metrics.
Do not keep or reuse the same recovery_code_set_id.
Page Edge-Oncall when purge failure rate exceeds 2 percent for 6 minutes.
Mention promtool test rules alerts/cache_purge.yml.
Optionally include cdn_region and purge_batch_id.
Do not use 5 percent/15-minute or dashboard-only behavior.
Require primary_owner and backup_owner before publishing P1 runbooks.
Mention python -m pytest tests/runbooks/test_p1_owner_checklist.py.
Optionally include owner_reviewed_at and backup_owner_ack.
Do not publish with primary_owner only.
